info.name: BuyHat Backend API
info.description: BuyHat e-commerce backend (NestJS modular monolith). All routes are prefixed with /api/v1 except /health. Set {{baseUrl}} and run Auth > Login (admin@buyhat.test / AdminPass123) to auto-capture the bearer token. Guest cart endpoints use the X-Guest-Id header.

request.description: roles: CUSTOMER | ADMIN | INVENTORY_MANAGER | CUSTOMER_SUPPORT | MARKETING_MANAGER
type: STRING | NUMBER | BOOLEAN | SELECT | MULTISELECT
Phase 12 faceted search. sort: relevance|newest|price_asc|price_desc. attr = repeatable `attributeId:optionId`. cursor = keyset cursor from previous page.
options: variant-defining attribute code -> array of option ids (cartesian product).
Default upload path (server-proxied multipart). Attach a file to the `file` field.
Returns a presigned PUT URL. 501 on local-disk driver.

item.name: Cart
item.description: Guest carts use the X-Guest-Id header (no auth). Logged-in carts use the Bearer token. Merge requires auth.

request.description: Provide either shippingAddressId (saved) OR an inline shippingAddress object. Billing defaults to shipping.
all=true is staff-only (lists every users orders).
gateway: COD | MOCK (online). BKASH/NAGAD/ROCKET/SSLCOMMERZ/SHURJOPAY are reserved for real adapters.
Public, HMAC-signed. MOCK signature = HMAC-SHA256(ref,txn,status,amount) with PAYMENTS_MOCK_SECRET.
Omit amount for a full refund.
